name: animated-beam
title: Animated Beam
blurb: Animated gradient line flowing between two elements.
description: Renders an SVG path that animates a gradient beam flowing from one DOM element to another. Supports customizable curve, direction, speed, and repeat.
use_when: System diagrams, data flow visualizations, or connection indicators between UI elements.
avoid_when: Motion-sensitive users (no prefers-reduced-motion); complex layouts (ref tracking overhead).
a11y: SVG overlay; no interactive elements. Motion-based only, no semantic content.
